findings.claim: The Pages path filter omits package-build inputs, so packed API documentation can become stale without the deployment workflow running.
findings.evidence: Both filters omit shared package build scripts consumed by build:packages and docs:api.
findings.suggested_fix: Include every shared package-build input in both path filters.

findings.claim: The evidence publisher copies original PNGs verbatim without the secret or internal-path scanning promised by the public security documentation.
findings.evidence: PNG sources are copied verbatim while the text scanner does not inspect pixels or image metadata.
findings.suggested_fix: Re-encode originals, hash-pin manual visual review, enforce nonblank/dimension checks, and narrow the public automation claim.

findings.claim: A successful receipt is not bound to the image it purportedly verifies, allowing an unrelated passing receipt to certify an arbitrary allowlisted screenshot.
findings.evidence: The generator hashes receipt and source independently but does not compare them to an approved binding.
findings.suggested_fix: Require exact source and receipt hashes in the allowlist and compare both before publication.

findings.claim: The local-search asset check is ineffective because the generated search page itself satisfies the filename test even when search-index.json is missing.
findings.evidence: Any basename matching search sets searchAsset true, including search/index.html.
findings.suggested_fix: Require build/search-index.json directly and remove the basename heuristic.
